content:
The financial disclosure of Andrej Plenković, leader of Croatia's conservative HDZ, appeared quite unexpectedly in an apparition at the Catholic shrine of Međugorje, less than a week before the parliamentary election. The apparition came as a breath of fresh air to the long-suffering people, many of whom had already turned into skeptics.

Oglas

"I thought the new leader of our Croatian Democratic Parish was poor, and I was already terrified that we would be led by someone who isn't any better than the rest of us. But when his financial disclosure appeared, my eyes lit up and a kind of tranquility washed over me. Why, he has both cars and real estate, and he knows how to provide for his family. That's how he'll provide for his people, who are one big family," recounted a believer who was baptized into the party back in the nineties.

Through divine intervention, the Croatian Democratic Parish thus once again escaped a potential election flop, proving that God forgives and is still on their side.

"I was a bit scared that this year our priest would advise us to vote for the parish against our conscience because of all those so-called scandals the media make mountains out of, but it turns out God is merciful and forgives absolutely everything. Except communism, of course," says Tvrtko Kamen, one of the faithful voters.

We asked Tvrtko who he would vote for if he didn't know the financial standing of the HDZ leader, or if he knew for a fact that he was a thief. He told us he would vote the same, because he is only human and cannot judge others.
